values.meaning: Increased move speed while facing enemy champions
values.binNote: MoveSpeedAmpTowardsEnemies (1.75) is a multiplier, not the final percentage; the wiki's 43.75% equals BaseMoveSpeed (0.25) x MoveSpeedAmpTowardsEnemies (1.75), matching the ShyvanaW#MoveSpeedTowardsEnemies calculation exactly.

values.meaning: Dragon Form recast heal, missing health scaling
values.binNote: Bin's Calc_Heal_Min/Calc_Heal_Max formulas (byLevel 75..200, with bonus AD and AP terms) do not match the wiki's stated recast heal values (byLevel 60..100, missing health only, no AD/AP ratio); the wiki quote instead matches ShyvanaW#Calc_Base_Heal and Calc_Missing_Health_Heal, a separate pair of calculations with no AD/AP scaling terms. Treating the wiki's own quoted values as authoritative here. MissingHealthHealMultiplier (2) and Calc_Heal_Max/Calc_Heal_Min appear to belong to that alternate, unused formula pair.

mechanics.claim: Inferno Aegis can be recast after 1 second while the shield holds, and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.
mechanics.quote: After 1 second, ''Inferno Aegis'' can be recast while the shield holds and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.

mechanics.claim: The recast explosion deals magic damage to nearby enemies, a separate damage instance from the shield application.
mechanics.quote: '''Shyvana''' consumes the shield to explode, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.

mechanics.claim: Shield strength is increased by 30% for every nearby enemy champion.
mechanics.quote: with the shield strength increased by 30% for every nearby enemy champion

mechanics.claim: In Dragon Form, if the explosion hits an enemy champion, Shyvana heals based on missing health.
mechanics.quote: If the explosion hits an enemy champion, '''Shyvana''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for {{pp|60 + (100-60)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{pp|4 + (8-4)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} '''missing''' health)}}.

mechanics.claim: This ability has no cast time.
Inferno Aegis has spell shield interaction (can be blocked by spell shields).
